title: Mono Oxygen Bangtao Beach
shortDescription: A small gated enclave of six villas in the Bang Tao beach area, sold by the Mono brand.
description: A small gated enclave of six villas in the Bang Tao beach area, sold by the Mono brand. Per portal listings the three-bedroom units each have a private pool, and only one remained on sale at the time of the portal check.
